article.introduction: The 69-player FedEx St. Jude Championship field at TPC Southwind shows Jake Knapp, Scottie Scheffler, and Jacob Bridgeman as the top three model ranks with SG Total values of 002, 868, and 933. All three players carry the same contextual profile: skipped the Scottish Open, zero tracked rounds in the major swing workload window, and safe FedExCup top-50 status. The model weights SG APP at 3% and SG Total at 0%, aligning with the strengths shown by these three.

sections.heading: Tournament Overview
sections.body: The 69-player FedEx St. Jude Championship at TPC Southwind carries course weights of SG APP 3%, SG Total 0%, and SG PUTT 5%. The top 20 model ranks show SG Total values ranging from 002 (Knapp) to 238 (Hisatsune).

sections.heading: Course Fit

sections.heading: Crossover Research Angles

sections.heading: Outright Targets
